meta.title: AI SEO Audit Tool - Technical SEO Analysis & Website SEO Checker | SeeO
meta.description: SeeO is an AI SEO audit tool: crawl your site, run 20+ technical checks, and get a technical SEO analysis with health score and a clear SEO audit report.

seoAudit.title: AI SEO Audit Tool for Complete Website SEO Analysis
seoAudit.subtitle: Crawl your website, run technical checks page by page, and know exactly what to fix first — ranked by score and priority, with SEO issues detection across 20+ checks
seoAudit.whatItDoes: SeeO's AI SEO audit tool crawls a target site automatically, runs 20+ technical SEO checks on every page, rolls the results into a health score (0–100), and lists issues with corresponding fixes ordered by priority. Think of it as a website SEO checker that goes far beyond a single homepage snapshot: every crawled page is inspected for on-page basics, indexability, security, performance, and link structure problems, so SEO issues detection happens in one pass instead of across five separate tools. Each technical SEO audit run is saved to history, so you can compare scores and issue counts over time and verify that your fixes actually moved the numbers. The SEO audit report groups every finding by category and severity, so triage takes minutes instead of hours — fix the high-impact errors first, then work through warnings and notices as capacity allows. Because every run is stored, the report doubles as a progress log: watch the health score climb and the issue count drop as fixes land. Nothing needs to be installed; the audit runs server-side against public pages and works the same way on static sites, framework apps, WordPress, or large e-commerce catalogs.

process: In-house crawler (server-side fetching based on cheerio) retrieves page HTML for each URL, following same-domain links up to the crawl limit
Runs 20+ rule-based checks on each page — the core of every technical SEO audit, from title tags to SSL
Computes a health score weighted across checks so severity reflects real impact
Ranks issues by impact rather than the order they were found
Groups findings by category and severity for faster triage
Writes the run to audit history for later comparison
output: Issue list with fix recommendations ordered by priority
PDF / Excel SEO audit reports for sharing (Pro)
how.dataSource: SeeO's own crawler fetches the target site directly — no third-party data API involved

checks.items: Title tags, meta descriptions, H1 heading hierarchy, image alt text, and word-count basics — the on-page fundamentals every website SEO checker should cover before anything else
Canonical tags, robots.txt rules, sitemap presence, noindex detection, and redirect chains that can quietly block indexing on otherwise healthy pages
SSL certificate validity, page load performance, and mobile readiness signals — the trust and speed factors search engines weigh
Internal link structure, broken link detection, and orphaned-page risks that starve important pages of authority

who: Site owners who need regular technical health checks instead of one-off scans
Teams verifying a redesign or migration didn't introduce regressions
Anyone taking over a new site who needs a fast, defensible baseline

faqs.q: Do I need an account to audit a website?
faqs.a: The homepage offers a no-signup single-page quick audit — enter a URL and see basic checks immediately. Saving audit history, running full-site audits, and comparing history require a free account.

20+ technical SEO checks covering title tags, meta descriptions, H1 hierarchy, image alt text, canonical, SSL certificates, robots.txt, sitemap, mobile readiness, and page performance. Each check maps to a category — on-page basics, indexability, security and performance, link structure — and every issue carries a severity so you can triage.

Two depths: quick mode audits 1 page; full mode crawls from your sitemap with a maximum of 50 pages. Quick mode suits a landing-page sanity check; full mode follows your sitemap so nothing important is skipped.

Every audit produces a 0–100 health score (weighted across checks), a priority-ranked issue list with fix suggestions, and comparison against previous audits. That makes it easy to report progress to a client or manager in one number instead of a spreadsheet.

Yes — PDF and Excel export is included in the Pro plan, so your SEO audit report can be shared with clients or stakeholders as-is. Exports keep the health score, issue list, and fix recommendations intact, so the document is ready to send without editing.

faqs.q: Is there a limit on audit frequency?
faqs.a: Yes, audits are limited per day; the quota depends on your plan (see the pricing page).

faqs.q: What makes SeeO different from other website SEO checker tools?
faqs.a: Most checkers stop at a single page. SeeO crawls up to 50 pages per run, scores every page, keeps full audit history, and connects results to rank tracking, keyword research, and backlink data on the same workbench — so improvements are provable rather than anecdotal.

meta.description: SeeO is an SEO rank tracker for keyword rank tracking by keyword, location, and device — daily SERP positions, history trends, and volatility alerts.

rankTracking.title: SEO Rank Tracker for Monitoring Keyword Rankings
rankTracking.subtitle: Your real Google positions recorded automatically every day — know immediately when rankings move, with complete SERP position tracking and ranking history per keyword, location, and device
rankTracking.whatItDoes: SeeO's keyword rank tracking tool monitors Google search positions across four dimensions: keyword × domain × location × device. As your SEO rank tracker, it refreshes positions automatically once a day and writes every result to ranking history, so you can view a trend curve for each keyword and get an alert whenever rankings move significantly. SERP position tracking covers both desktop and mobile results for the locations you care about, and identical queries are cached for 24 hours to keep usage efficient. This Google rank tracker runs on a daily schedule whether you track ten keywords or hundreds — no manual checks, no spreadsheets, no guessing whether yesterday's optimization actually worked. Every keyword keeps its own trend curve built from the full record of past positions, so "are we improving?" becomes a chart instead of a debate. The alert threshold catches genuine movements — a jump into the top 3, a drop off page one, or sudden volatility across the whole keyword set — while daily granularity shows the step-by-step effect of each change you ship. Because desktop and mobile are recorded separately, you can also spot device-specific problems, like a page that ranks well on desktop search but disappears on mobile.

Once a day via a scheduled job; you can also trigger a manual refresh on the rank tracking page — up to 20 keywords per request. If a client asks for Tuesday's numbers, trigger a refresh and the trend curve picks up where the scheduled run left off.

faqs.q: Can I track rankings by location and device?
faqs.a: Yes. Each keyword can specify a location and device (desktop / mobile); rankings are recorded per dimension. This matters most for local businesses, where a keyword can sit on page one in one city and page three in another.

faqs.q: Do repeated queries for the same keyword consume quota twice?
faqs.a: No. Queries with identical parameters (keyword + domain + location + device) reuse a 24-hour cache without calling SerpApi again.

faqs.q: Will I be notified of rank changes?
faqs.a: Yes. After each refresh, significant movements automatically generate alerts you can view in-app. Alerts include the keyword, the old and new position, and the direction — enough context to act without opening the full report.

faqs.q: Do I need an account to use rank tracking?
faqs.a: Yes. Rank tracking keeps continuous history, so you need a free account to add projects and keywords. The account also keeps your keyword groups and project settings in one place.

faqs.q: What makes SeeO different from other rank tracking tools?
faqs.a: The SEO rank tracker sits on the same workbench as technical audits, keyword research, and backlink data, so a ranking drop can be investigated next to the technical issue or lost link that caused it — no exporting between tools. That shortens the loop between "rankings dropped" and "here's why" to minutes instead of days.

meta.title: Backlink Analysis Tool - SEO Backlink Checker & Link Analysis | SeeO
meta.description: SeeO's backlink analysis tool works as your backlink checker: analyze SEO backlinks, referring domains, Domain Rank, dofollow ratio, and anchor text.

backlinks.title: Backlink Analysis Tool for SEO Link Monitoring
backlinks.subtitle: See the scale, quality, and composition of links pointing to your site — a backlink monitoring tool for your entire link profile
backlinks.whatItDoes: Backlink analysis pulls the complete link profile of a domain: total backlinks, referring domains, Domain Rank, and dofollow ratio, plus individual link details — source page, anchor text, target page, and first-seen date. Use it as a backlink checker before a link-building campaign, an SEO backlink analyzer for competitor research, or a backlink monitoring tool to watch link growth and loss across refreshes. Link profile analysis and anchor text analysis surface which domains and phrases drive your links, so you can judge quality, spot risky patterns early, and prove that link-building work is paying off. The anchor text view is often where risk hides: an over-optimized exact-match pattern is a classic penalty signal, while a natural mix of branded and generic anchors points to a healthy profile. Growth and loss trends let you catch a lost link the week it disappears instead of months later, and comparing your distribution against a competitor gives link-building targets a concrete shape — which domains to pursue, which anchors to vary, and which pages on your site attract links naturally. Results are cached for 7 days, so you can compare across refreshes.
